archetypes.name: design-flow
archetypes.rationale: Prompt-only sequencing changes can regress /design turn ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design SKILL.md changes as an orchestrator contract. Focus on whether Step 3 table output, notification gating, and Step 4 rejected-findings emission are internally consistent and do not reintroduce stale pre-launch output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: report-framing
archetypes.rationale: Rejected-findings framing crosses Python CLI and Bash wrapper surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan-review emit-rejected CLI, tail wrapper, and tests together. Focus on empty output behavior, raw file preservation, CLI failure fallback framing, and byte-compatible default behavior without --report-framing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
